dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: On the topic of kidnapping cases...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: How exactly do we define the subject of a kidnapping? According to the regulations, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Aside from humans, do pets count? What about sentient non-human beings?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Of course, Melusines go without saying, but what about a being like Cacucu?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I am surprised that you're unfamiliar with the legal provisions on this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Haha, if I knew all the laws like the back of my hand, I wouldn't have ended up in the Fortress of Meropide, would I?
